title: Tours and extras around your cruise
standfirst: Day trips, transfers and extras you can add before, during or after a Nile cruise, run by our offices in Luxor and Aswan. Each is booked separately from the cruise.

sections.heading: How tours work
paragraphs: Tours are sold separately from cruises, with their own price, terms and payment. Most can be shared with other guests or taken privately; transfers are always private. Prices are coming soon: until then, each page explains the tour.

faqs.q: Can I book a tour without a cruise?
faqs.a: Yes. Anyone signed in can book a tour; if you have a cruise, the dates it is moored nearby are suggested.

seoTitle: Nile cruise excursions, tours and transfers
seoDescription: Day trips, airport transfers and extras to add around a Nile cruise, run by our offices in Luxor and Aswan.
